denominator: public top-level Java source types; not methods or engineering operations
interpretation: Mentions and declared routes do not prove execution, full class exposure or engineering qualification. Explicit supported operations are bounded to their recorded signatures, units, applicability and examples.

capabilities.title: Experimental ideal translating check-valve acoustic screening
capabilities.limitations: EXPERIMENTAL ideal translating equal-pressure/swept-area single-liquid model with backward Euler, previous-lift orifice area and perfectly inelastic discrete contact. Signed flow and local energy/conservation/restart verification do not qualify vendor slam, mesh-independent sharp-front impact, full pump trips, cavitation, global Safety Shutdown, structural loads or asset approval.

capabilities.title: Steady-state compressor minimum-flow circulation
capabilities.limitations: Java/Python object API discovered through inspectApi; not a runProcess JSON equipment type. Fixed minimum, same-composition return at suction state; no dynamic anti-surge qualification.

capabilities.title: Bounded saturated-liquid viscosity and dense-fluid conductivity estimation
capabilities.limitations: Correlation evaluation only, not experimental qualification. Letsou-Stiel estimates pure saturated-liquid viscosity without mixture or pressure correction. Chung takes pure-fluid or supplied conformal parameters. CO2 uses the Laesecke-Muzny background correlation without critical enhancement and requires a separately established physical gas or compressed-fluid state. The dilute-only CO2 API explicitly permits extrapolation above 2000 K. Default model selection is unchanged; the background CO2 implementation also serves the existing Span-Wagner default.

operations.applicability: Finite positive T, M, Tc and Pc, finite acentric factor and 0.76 <= T/Tc <= 0.98. Saturated-liquid estimate only, no pressure correction or mixture rule.

Original Chung conductivity coefficients, finite positive required constants, nonnegative density and association, 0.3 <= 1.2593*T/Tc <= 100 and packing fraction below one. No critical enhancement or universal accuracy claim.

Pure CO2 background viscosity, 100 <= T <= 2000 K, finite nonnegative mass density. Includes dilute, initial-density and residual terms, excludes critical enhancement. Callers must establish a physical fluid state inside the published gas/compressed-fluid domain; scalar checks do not enforce melting or phase stability.
Pure CO2 zero-density viscosity. 100 <= T <= 10000 K; values above 2000 K are the explicitly documented extrapolation, not finite-density predictions.

capabilities.title: Frozen-EOS compositional tank replay and bounded volume matching
capabilities.limitations: Discovery and inspectApi only; instance-based Java/Python API. Frozen laboratory EOS, fixed-temperature pore volume and supplied initial phase fractions. Original measured-component mode preserves prescribed composition. Opt-in equilibrium-phase molar extraction predicts produced component amounts using explicit substeps; refine pressure/composition/outputs and reject unavailable or exhausted phases. PvtSeparatorPath gives component-conservative equilibrium surface products on an explicit final T/P basis, retaining offgas condensate and water. No inferred phase rates, relative permeability, well deliverability or measured surface-rate inversion. Pressure-only bounded volume matching/heldouts and optional segregated finite aquifer retain their existing limits; aquifer water cannot be produced as EOS aqueous phase. Synthetic/analytical/direct-EOS checks are not independent public laboratory-to-field or measured produced-phase validation. No EOS retuning, rock/thermal/spatial model, correlated-error inference or recoverable-reserves claim.

capabilities.title: Mechanistic corrosion screening
capabilities.limitations: Screening does not establish plant integrity or inhibitor performance.

capabilities.title: Native CCE/CVD/DLE laboratory path and bounded generalized PVT
capabilities.limitations: Discovery and inspectApi only; instance data/protocol inputs, no executable static MCP operation. Modified-black-oil generate requires a dry sample with gas and oil at every pressure, a fixed separator basis, separately accepted pure-water Bw and caller-justified surface conversion tolerance. Native replayNative preserves selected original/tuned EOS and complete experiment identity. Path.CCE uses ConstantMassExpansion.runNativeExpansion for closed-mass absolute states without a saturation scan or withdrawal; numerical closure error is not production. Oil-only DLE and pre-dew gas-only CVD are supported within their recorded bounds. CVD requires a sampled gas/oil boundary and rejects later disappearance tails; native upper-dew refinement now checks the scan-selected branch, normalized nontrivial phase compositions and log-fugacity closure; the declared binary independent reference passes. Legacy default and modified-black-oil generation retain the scan and its precision limitation. Wet/critical-degenerate paths remain unqualified. No invented absent-phase Bo/Bg/Rs/Rv, saturation-normalized CCE values, measured laboratory/field accuracy or recoverable-reserves claim.

capabilities.title: Bounded dynamic process study
capabilities.limitations: Not all equipment provides a qualified transient model; preserve initial conditions and event assumptions.

capabilities.title: Electrolyte scale screening
capabilities.limitations: Parameter availability, minerals and validity ranges must be checked for each brine.

capabilities.title: Bounded engineering unit conversions
capabilities.limitations: Only the listed pure static conversions are supported. Rate conversions that depend on fluid state, composition, or standard conditions remain outside this contract.

operations.applicability: Absolute and gauge pressure conversions using the explicit source and target units; gauge conversions use NeqSim's fixed reference atmosphere.
Signed pressure-difference conversions without atmospheric offsets; gauge aliases use the corresponding absolute scale.
Absolute temperature conversions. Use convertDifference for temperature intervals.
Temperature interval conversions without absolute-scale offsets.
Linear length conversions between the accepted unit symbols and aliases.
Linear elapsed-time conversions between the accepted unit symbols and aliases.
Linear power conversions between the accepted engineering units.
Linear energy conversions between the accepted engineering units.

capabilities.title: Separator and compressor sizing
capabilities.limitations: Sizing support does not expose every mechanical-design API or certify a design.

capabilities.title: Static exponential production-decline screening
capabilities.limitations: Arps exponential (b = 0) screening only, with unit-consistent non-negative rates, daily nominal decline and elapsed days. It does not establish boundary-dominated flow, forecast uncertainty, reserves classification, economics, facility constraints or development approval.

operations.applicability: Arps exponential production-rate screening for finite non-negative initial rate, nominal daily decline and elapsed time.
Integrated Arps exponential production for finite non-negative initial rate, nominal daily decline and elapsed time.
Exponential-decline conversion for a finite non-negative nominal daily decline rate using 365.25 days/year.
Exponential-decline conversion for a finite effective annual decline fraction strictly between 0 and 1 using 365.25 days/year.
Two-point exponential decline estimate for finite positive rates with the second rate lower and the second time later.

capabilities.title: Production profiles and cash flow
capabilities.limitations: Economic assumptions and fiscal-model applicability remain explicit caller inputs.

capabilities.title: Physical finite-aquifer measured-history replay
capabilities.limitations: Discovery and inspectApi only; Java/Python object workflow, no new static MCP operation. Constant-property Fetkovich reservoir-volume storage, exact prescribed linear-pressure integration, implicit fixed-pore-volume EOS coupling through segregated immiscible water. Aquifer water cannot mix or be produced through component schedules; interval minimum/maximum water volumes bound admissible roots. Known aquifer properties may be supplied for bounded volume fitting. No rock/thermal/spatial behavior, continuous joint identifiability, independent field qualification or recoverable reserves.

capabilities.title: Static sweet-gas pseudopressure screening
capabilities.limitations: Correlation-only sweet-gas screening using canonical Standing pseudocritical properties, Hall-Yarborough Z-factor and Lee-Gonzalez-Eakin viscosity. Both absolute pressures and molecular weight must be positive, gas specific gravity must remain from 0.55 through 1.80, reduced temperature must exceed 1.0 and maximum reduced pressure must remain below 25. It does not qualify sour-gas corrections, compositional EOS phase behavior, well deliverability or engineering approval.

operations.applicability: Finite positive absolute pressures and molecular weight; Standing gas specific gravity from 0.55 through 1.80; Hall-Yarborough reduced temperature above 1.0 and maximum reduced pressure below 25.0.
Finite positive absolute pressures and molecular weight; Standing gas specific gravity from 0.55 through 1.80; Hall-Yarborough reduced temperature above 1.0 and maximum reduced pressure below 25.0.

capabilities.title: Generalized reservoir history balance with vaporized oil
capabilities.limitations: Discovery and inspectApi only; instance-based Java/Python history builder, no executable static MCP operation. Two surface components with independently calibrated, path-consistent PVT and net cumulative withdrawals on one surface basis. Aquifer influx and rock/water expansion are supplied, not fitted. Synthetic conservation and tank/EOS tests are not independent laboratory/field qualification, pressure-error statistics, full compositional injection, recoverable reserves or confidence intervals. The SimpleReservoir adapter rejects unrecorded injection and truncated/nonzero-origin history. CalibratedPvtModel freezes original/tuned EOS checkpoints and compares complete independently identified CCE/CVD/DLE/separator holdouts through existing solvers. MaterialBalancePvtHistory validates declared path, standard basis and measured-pressure alignment; records and path-validation evidence remain externally supplied. Identity checks cannot establish laboratory independence or qualify CVD-to-generalized-PVT conversion.

capabilities.title: Source-identified laboratory gas density interval consistency
capabilities.limitations: Discovery and inspectApi only; instance-based Java/JPype evidence, no stateless MCP execution route. Opt-in same-state gas p/T/Z/molar-mass/density interval identity check using explicit SI inputs and caller-justified absolute bounds; preserves source/raw data and rejects incompatible same-sample checkpoint attachments. Conservative box bounds are not sigmas, correlated inference, EOS calibration, protocol replay or independent accuracy. Public primary Duvernay table18 is a consistency fixture: 8 of 9 tuples compatible under printed-resolution bounds, saturation row retained and incompatible; final pressure is 1300 psia. Does not qualify measured laboratory-to-field matching, absent phases or the Tran rescaled-CVD method.

capabilities.title: Compose a multi-area process
capabilities.limitations: Only canonical process-JSON connections and preserved properties are supported.

capabilities.title: Experimental post-pigging gas/aqueous film transfer
capabilities.limitations: Experimental Java/Python route only; configure finite-rate transfer and independent initial aqueous inventory. Isothermal Euler with CFL <= 0.5, gas/aqueous only, no tracked slugs. Long-time drying and experimental duration accuracy are not qualified; not exposed by runPipeline.

capabilities.title: Steady and two-fluid pipeline calculations
capabilities.limitations: Select the applicable solver and closures; transient behavior needs case-specific validation.

capabilities.title: Experimental prescribed-pressure pig mechanics (API discovery only)
capabilities.limitations: Experimental Java/JPype mechanical submodel only. inspectApi discovers constructors and methods; no curated execution operation, TwoFluidPipe coupling, bypass, receiver, experimental pigging qualification or physical flowline-restart claim. See docs/process/pig-motion.md.

capabilities.title: Compressor in a process model
capabilities.limitations: Vendor maps, operating envelope and driver limits need separate qualification.

capabilities.title: Build and solve a separation train
capabilities.limitations: Registration covers JSON builder support, not all equipment setters or every topology.

capabilities.title: CME and CVD experiments
capabilities.limitations: Experimental input and fluid characterization must be supplied; test presence is not a fluid-specific calibration.

capabilities.title: Traceable PVT characterization study and E300 handover
capabilities.limitations: Discovery and inspectApi route only; execute the complete study through neqsim pvt-study or the documented Python/Java adapter. Bounded plain cubic hydrocarbon models, classic mixing and CCE relative-volume BIP fitting only. Synthetic examples establish numerical workflow/replay, not independent experimental accuracy or target-simulator compatibility.

capabilities.title: Discrete joint Bayesian pressure-history hypotheses
capabilities.limitations: Discovery and inspectApi only; Java/Python object workflow, no new static MCP operation. Explicit joint prior probability masses propagate pore volume, initial phase fractions, optional finite-aquifer, accepted PVT model and measured-flow realizations using common independent Gaussian pressure errors. Held-out pressures excluded; rejected prior mass, correlations, prior shifts and lower-tail model forecast quantiles retained. Centered likelihoods preserve prior odds at huge common finite residual offsets. Grid refinement and independent field qualification remain required. No continuous posterior identifiability proof, automatic uncertainty distributions, correlated errors, ES-MDA, water mixing or recoverable-reserves estimate.

capabilities.title: Static slug impact-force screening
capabilities.limitations: Homogeneous momentum-force screening only. Inputs, bend geometry, dynamic load factor, support response, vibration, fatigue, and piping-code acceptance require independent engineering review.

operations.applicability: Homogeneous no-slip slug density for positive liquid density, non-negative gas density, and gas void fraction from 0 through 1.
Axial momentum-force screening for positive density and flow area; the signed velocity is squared.
Bend reaction-force magnitude for positive density and area and an engineering bend angle from 0 through 180 degrees.

operations.signature: double neqsim.process.equipment.pipeline.SlugImpactForce.designForce(double, double, double, double, double, double)
operations.applicability: Homogeneous two-phase slug momentum-force screening with caller-supplied dynamic load factor; it is not a qualified piping design.
Circular flow area for a positive internal pipe diameter.

capabilities.title: Static sulfur vapour pressure
capabilities.limitations: Search for calculateVapourPressureBar and invoke its exact double signature; this does not qualify other methods.

operations.applicability: Pure sulfur vapour pressure for 312.15 K through 1308.15 K; values outside the correlation range are rejected.

capabilities.title: Detailed steady SURF network hydraulic fidelity
capabilities.limitations: Discovery through runCapability inspectApi only; these instance-based Java/Python graph builders have no executable static MCP operation registered. FieldNetworkTopology is a typed identity/port view over LoopedPipeNetwork, not a second solver, and runtime equipment bindings are not serialized. FieldWellNetworkCoupler iterates live WellSystem and production/injection WellFlow pressure-rate boundaries against that same graph; it requires NEWTON_RAPHSON and does not own reservoir depletion. Edge-local Darcy/Beggs-Brill/two-fluid steady calculations remain independently selectable. Independent field qualification, controlled steady-to-transient initialization and mixed-fidelity network transients remain campaign work; integration and conservation tests are not field qualification.

capabilities.title: Static sweet-gas pseudocritical property screening
capabilities.limitations: Standing and Sutton sweet-gas correlation screening only, using gas specific gravity relative to air within each published range. It does not qualify sour/non-hydrocarbon corrections, composition-derived pseudocritical mixing, EOS phase behavior, reservoir deliverability or engineering approval.

operations.applicability: Standing sweet-gas correlation for finite gas specific gravity from 0.55 through 1.80.
Standing sweet-gas correlation for finite gas specific gravity from 0.55 through 1.80.
Sutton sweet-gas correlation for finite gas specific gravity from 0.57 through 1.68.
Sutton sweet-gas correlation for finite gas specific gravity from 0.57 through 1.68.

capabilities.title: TP flash of a defined fluid
capabilities.limitations: Only models and flash modes supported by run_flash schema; not every thermodynamic system or operation.

capabilities.title: VFPPROD table-driven pipeline hydraulics
capabilities.limitations: Discovery/inspectApi route for composable Java/JPype objects, not a curated stateless MCP tool. Only METRIC GAS/WGR/GOR-or-OGR VFPPROD with singleton ALQ. Explicit temperature and provider-matched surface-volume definition required. No extrapolation, thermal prediction or network balancing. Synthetic analytical tests do not qualify supplied field hydraulics.

capabilities.title: Pure-fluid saturation latent heat from a measured reference
capabilities.limitations: Opt-in Watson (1943) reference-state estimate with exponent 0.38. Caller supplies pure-fluid saturation reference data; no mixture rule, pressure correction, database parameter repair, critical-region accuracy or universal uncertainty claim. Six benzene calorimetry points are checked at 307-353 K; other fluids/ranges need validation.

operations.applicability: Finite 0<T<=Tc, 0<Tref<Tc and Href>0. Returns the model zero at T=Tc; rejects supercritical input and nonrepresentable positive subcritical results. Saturated pure-fluid estimate only; mathematical domain is not physical qualification.
